pieces.name: sculpture_lid
pieces.style: minimalist asymmetric arch with a rounded crown and a steep tapered void, printed as one piece with the lid it stands on
pieces.use_suggestion: Lifts off the box by the sculpture itself. The headband rests across the rounded crown and the ear cups hang clear either side of the slim blade, so the piece reads as a sculpture first and a stand second.
pieces.print_note: Print lid-down on the bed with the arch rising: the outer surface narrows all the way up and the void walls sit about 76 degrees, so nothing overhangs.

pieces.name: storage_box
pieces.style: soft-cornered open box with an internal rabbet the lid drops into flush
pieces.use_suggestion: Holds cables, adapters, dongles and spare ear pads under the stand. Fill it to add ballast and the stand gets harder to tip.
pieces.print_note: Print upright as modelled — every wall is vertical and the rabbet faces upward, so no supports.

material_note: Prints cleanly in PLA; a matte or silk filament suits the form. Print both parts in the same material for a consistent finish.
